newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran, Russia to sign deal to make planes - IRNA.
newsitem.headline: Iran, Russia to sign deal to make planes - IRNA.

text.p: Tehran and Moscow are expected to sign a deal to manufacture Russian Tupolev Tu-334 aircraft in Iran, the Iranian news agency said on Wednesday.

It gave no further details but said the agreement would be signed during a five-day visit to Moscow, starting Thursday, by Iran's Parliamentary Speaker Ali Akbar Nateq-Nouri, a leading candidate in next month's presidential elections.
IRNA said Nateq-Nouri would also sign accords on the manufacture of underground locomotives and other agreements to boost industrial, cultural and scientific cooperation.
Iran ordered 12 new-build Tupolev Tu-154s from Russia last September.
Nateq-Nouri, accompanied by several cabinet ministers and parliament deputies, is expected to meet President Boris Yeltsin and other senior Russian officials during the trip.
Iran has good ties with Russia which has signed an $800 million deal to complete an Iranian nuclear power plant despite opposition from the United States.
